ai.sellerResponse:
Ready to become a ShopNekt seller? Here's how to get started:

1. Open Your Store — Fill in your shop details at /open-store
2. Choose Your Market — Business Market or Campus Market
3. Get Approved — Our team reviews your application within 24 hours
4. Start Selling — Add products and go live immediately!

ShopNekt sellers get AI-powered tools, real-time analytics, WhatsApp notifications, and access to thousands of buyers across Tanzania and beyond.

Visit: shopnekt.vercel.app/open-store
ai.trackOrderResponse:
To track your order, contact the seller directly via WhatsApp — you'll find their contact on the store page where you placed your order.

You can also search for the shop name in the Market section and message the seller directly.
ai.compareResponse:
I can help you compare! Tell me the names of two products or shops you'd like to compare. For example:

"Compare Fashion Hub and Style Palace"
"Compare Samsung vs iPhone on ShopNekt"

I'll search for both and give you a clear side-by-side summary.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and username when you create an account. We also collect usage data to improve your experience.
privacy.s2Body: Your data is used to provide and improve ShopNekt services, process transactions, send notifications, and maintain account security. We never sell your personal data.
privacy.s3Body: We share your data with sellers only when necessary to complete a purchase. We do not share personal information with third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.s4Body: We use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. All payments are processed securely through verified payment providers.
privacy.s5Body: You can access, update, or delete your account data at any time through Settings. You can also request a full export of your data by contacting our support team.
privacy.s6Body: For privacy concerns, contact us at support@shopnekt.com or via WhatsApp at +255 651 919 915.
